title: Page 8
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
不过既然他已经找到她，就不会再让她吃苦，他疼她，宠她都来不及，怎能眼睁睁看着她过苦日子，这是他绝无法忍受的事情。
他会努力地弥补她，重新将她捧在掌心里护着，只要她愿意给他机会，他绝对会竭尽所能地表现。
“我不想和你回到戚家去。”宝安儿此刻的心情非常矛盾，既开心他追来，却又怨他的误会与不信任，最后还是选择拒绝他。
他们俩之间存在着因不信任而起的误解，所以除非他能全心信任她，要不然她是不会回去的。
戚无双微蹙起眉，试着想要说服她，“安儿，别再和我闹脾气了。”
“闹脾气又如何？”她的语气是异常的沉重，“我就是要让你知道，我才不希罕你们戚家的任何一毛钱，我宁愿在这里自食其力，也不要和你回去，被你认为我是个贪图荣华富贵的女人。”
“那些我已经不在乎了，我只想要你……”
“可是我在乎，而且是非常非常的在乎，”她打断他的话，不想听他继续说下去，“还有，那些首饰典当后变卖的钱，我也会想办法还给你，绝对不会贪你一分一毫，请你放心，另外，我这间破旧的小屋子没资格招待你这位贵客，请离开吧，我一早起来有许多工作要做，没多余的时间浪费在你身上。”
戚无双一愣，这才意识到自己一时心急之下说错话，反倒把情况弄得更是糟糕。
“安儿，我不是这个意……”
“我很忙，恕不奉陪。”
宝安儿将门给重重关起，将他隔绝在外头，不再多理，一将门给关上之后，她原本倔强的神情马上垮了下来，微红的眼眶也泛起了心酸的泪。
他的那一句不在乎真的伤透了她的心，对她来说就像是一种污辱及施舍，她希望他能认清事实，明白她是因为爱他才会嫁给他，所以才来带她回去，如果不是，那就没什么好说的。
戚无双看着大门当着他的面关起，内心忍不住懊恼，她的气还没消，她对他的怨怒还是很深，他如果硬闯，肯定会惹得她更生气，状况会越来越糟。
虽然他们是夫妻，他大可正大光明地将她给硬是带回去，但他不想这么做，他不希望只带回她的人，却带不回她的心，反倒让她对他的埋怨更深。
所以现在的他不能心急，得一步步想办法挽回她的心，至少他知道她就住在这里，他终于掌握到她的行踪，不必担心她又突然消失不见，这样就够了。
其他的事情都可以慢慢来，他会让她看到他的诚意，然后心甘情愿地回到他身边。
跟着戚无双过来的随从看到主子吃了一记闭门羹，担心地问：“大公子，现在该怎么办？”
“尽快在这儿附近租下一间房子，除非能够打动她，让她愿意和我回去，要不然我是暂时不会离开的。”他已经有个底，她不可能太快就重新接受他，他们势必得在这儿耗上一段时间。
不过得耗上多少时间都不要紧，他相信，只要他持之以恒，总有一天她的态度会软化下来的。

“是，小的马上派人去找。”
第9章(1)
戚无双当天就找到暂居的地方，而且还离宝安儿所住的房子不远，好就近注意她的一举一动，免得一不小心，又失去她的行踪。
第二天，他一早就守在门口，等她出门去市集，因为只有这么做，才能见到她，要不然她根本不让他进她房里，甚至连话都不想和他说。
好不容易终于等到宝安儿开门要出去做生意，戚无双赶紧解释。“安儿，其实我已经相信你是真的爱我，所以才会来找你的，昨天我只是一时说错……”
“是吗？但是不管你现在说什么，做什么，我都无法相信，所以可以麻烦你让开吗？我们还要赶着去做生意。”宝安儿面无表情地冷冷回道。
“……”她居然用当初他拒绝听她解释的话反过来堵他的嘴，她果真是气得不轻呀。
这就是所谓的现世报？罢了，他只能暂时让路，让她和贵叔顺利去做生意，继续想其他办法软化她的心。
宝安儿每天一早就和贵叔到市集上去卖肉包，直到夕阳即将西下才回来，在这个地方什么事情都是重新开始，所以他们的摊子生意也是从乏人问津开始，不像之前在宣河县时一样，不到一个早上就能把所有的包子都卖出去。
戚无双一连观察好几天包子摊的生意，真的非常心疼她在外头风吹日晒了一整天，还不一定能卖完包子，一时冲动之下，他来到摊子前，顾不得她到底愿不愿意见到他。
“安儿，你每天都出来卖包子太辛苦了，要不然我出钱把你的包子全都买下，你以后就直接把包子送到我住处那里，好吗？”
“戚无双，我宁愿把包子都拿去送给乞丐，也不想卖给你！”她越听越气，他真以为有钱就什么东西都买得到？她就偏不让他如愿！“请你让开，我还有许多包子得卖，你站在我的摊子前，会妨碍我做买卖。”
其他来来往往的路人纷纷停下脚步看好戏，低头互相交谈，很好奇现在是怎么一回事，卖包子的年轻少妇居然对着上门的客人咆哮，还气得火冒三丈，这里头肯定有问题。
宝安儿当着众人的面让戚无双吃一顿大瘪，却也不见他有任何不悦，反正他早已知道，她不会这么轻易就原谅他，这一点点的小挫折，他根本就不看在眼里。
他只是单纯地想帮她，只可惜不管他现在做什么，都会惹她气恼，但要是不帮她，他又于心不忍，心里更是难受。
他突然灵机一动，有了另一个好主意，既然她不想赚他的钱，那他就拐个弯帮她赚其他人的钱吧。
就见戚无双眉头微微蹙起，脸上带有淡淡的忧伤，转身对围观的众人说：“各位乡亲父老，其实我和娘子有些误会，伤了娘子的心，娘子才会离家出走来到这里，靠卖包子过活，但娘子的身子骨不是很好，我真的很担心她太过劳累，可以请大家多多捧场，好让我家娘子能够早点回去休息吗？”
原来这位公子是来寻妻的？众人叽叽喳喳，虽然不知道两人出了什么问题，但戚无双表现出一副深情的模样，倒是得到不少人的同情。
“那……那好吧，我买几个回家去吃。”率先被感动的是一位大婶，她的老公如果也能有这么深情的举动，她死也瞑目了，当然要帮他一把。
“那……那我也来几个。”某个年轻姑娘虽然非常惋惜这位俊公子已经娶妻，还是想帮他一把，希望自己也能找到这么一位好郎君呀！

“那我也来一个好了……”
“反正没吃过，就来一个吧……”
没想到戚无双只是蹙个眉头，就抓到不少人的同情怜悯之心，纷纷靠上前向宝安儿买包子，这让宝安儿忍不住傻眼，有种败下阵来的窝囊感。
难道她就真的没做生意的本事，一定得要靠他才行？
“如果觉得好吃的话，欢迎下次再来呀……”宝安儿傻愣在一旁，一时无法回过神来，贵叔则是笑嘻嘻地赶紧收钱装包子，一个接着一个卖，手脚利落得很，乐见现在的发展。
“感谢各位乡亲的帮忙。”戚无双有礼地向众人答谢，一副就是爱妻入骨的模样，更是深得人心呀。
“这位公子，要多努力一点啊，才能早点抱得妻子归……”
content_en:
But now that he has found her, he will not let her suffer anymore. He loves her and loves her too late. How can he watch her live a miserable life? This is something he cannot bear.
He will work hard to make it up to her and hold her in his hands to protect her again. As long as she is willing to give him a chance, he will definitely do his best to perform.
"I don't want to go back to Qi's house with you." Bao An'er was in a very contradictory mood at the moment. She was happy that he was chasing her, but she also complained about his misunderstanding and distrust, and finally chose to reject him.
There was a misunderstanding of distrust between them, so she would not go back unless he could trust her wholeheartedly.
Qi Wushuang frowned slightly and tried to persuade her, "An'er, don't get angry with me anymore."
"So what if you lose your temper?" Her tone was unusually heavy. "I just want you to know that I don't care for any of your Qi family's money. I would rather make a living here than go back with you and have you think that I am a woman who covets glory and wealth."
"I don't care about those anymore, I just want you..."
"But I care, and I care very, very much," she interrupted him, not wanting to hear him continue, "Also, I will also find a way to pay you back the money you get from the pawning of the jewelry, and I will never be greedy for a penny from you. Please rest assured. In addition, my shabby little house is not qualified to entertain you as a distinguished guest. Please leave. I have a lot of work to do when I get up early in the morning, and I don't have any extra time to waste on you."
Qi Wushuang was stunned for a moment, and then realized that he had said the wrong thing in a moment of impatience, which had made the situation worse.
"An'er, that's not what I meant..."
"I'm very busy, so I won't excuse you."
Bao An'er closed the door tightly to isolate him from the outside and stopped paying attention. As soon as the door was closed, her stubborn expression immediately collapsed, and sad tears filled her reddish eyes.
His words of not caring really broke her heart. It was like an insult and charity to her. She hoped that he could recognize the fact and understand that she married him because she loved him, so he came to take her back. If not, there would be nothing to say.
Qi Wushuang watched the door being closed in front of him, and couldn't help but feel annoyed. Her anger had not subsided, and her resentment towards him was still very deep. If he forced his way in, she would definitely make her even more angry, and the situation would get worse.
Although they were husband and wife, he could justly take her back, but he didn't want to do that. He didn't want to just bring her back, but not be able to bring back her heart, and instead make her complain about him even more.
So now he can't be impatient and have to think of ways to win back her heart step by step. At least he knows that she lives here. He finally has her whereabouts and doesn't have to worry about her suddenly disappearing again. That's enough.
Everything else can be done slowly, and he will let her see his sincerity and then return to him willingly.
The entourage who followed Qi Wushuang saw that his master had been rejected and asked worriedly: "Eldest Master, what should I do now?"
"Rent a house near here as soon as possible. Unless I can impress her and make her willing to go back with me, I won't leave for the time being." He already had a bottom line. She couldn't accept him again too quickly. They would have to spend a while here.
But it didn't matter how much time it took. He believed that as long as he persisted, one day her attitude would soften.
"Yes, I'll send someone to look for him right away."
Chapter 9(1)
Qi Wushuang found a temporary residence that day, and it was not far from the house where Bao An'er lived, so that he could pay close attention to her every move, so as not to accidentally lose her whereabouts again.
The next day, he stayed at the door early in the morning, waiting for her to go out to the market, because only in this way could he see her, otherwise she would not let him enter her room at all.I don't even want to talk to him.
Finally, when Bao An'er opened the door and was about to go out to do business, Qi Wushuang quickly explained. "An'er, actually I already believe that you really love me, that's why I came to you. I just made a mistake yesterday..."
"Really? But no matter what you say or do now, I can't believe it, so can you please get out of the way? We have to rush to do business." Bao An'er replied coldly with an expressionless face.
"..." She actually blocked his mouth with the words he refused to listen to her explanation. She was really angry.
Is this the so-called worldly report? That's all, he could only give way temporarily, let her and Uncle Gui go about their business smoothly, and continue to think of other ways to soften her heart.
Bao An'er and Uncle Gui go to the market early every morning to sell meat buns, and they don't come back until the sun is about to set. Everything in this place starts over, so their stall business also starts from a time when no one is interested. Unlike before in Xuanhe County, all the buns were sold in less than one morning.
Qi Wushuang observed the business of the steamed bun stall for several days, feeling really sorry that she might not be able to sell out all the steamed buns after being exposed in the wind and sun all day. On impulse, he came to the stall, not caring whether she wanted to see him or not.
"An'er, it's too hard for you to sell steamed buns every day. Otherwise, I will pay to buy all your steamed buns, and you can deliver the steamed buns directly to my residence from now on, okay?"
"Qi Wushuang, I would rather give all the buns to beggars than sell them to you!" The more she listened, the angrier she became. Did he really think he could buy anything if he had money? She just refused to let him get what he wanted! "Please get out of my way. I still have a lot of steamed buns to sell. If you stand in front of my stall, you will hinder my business."
Other passers-by stopped to watch the show, lowered their heads and talked to each other. They were curious about what was going on. The young woman selling steamed buns actually yelled at the customers who came to the door, and she was furious. There must be something wrong here.
Bao An'er gave Qi Wushuang a big meal in front of everyone, but he didn't see any displeasure on his part. Anyway, he already knew that she wouldn't forgive him so easily. He didn't notice this little setback at all.
He simply wanted to help her, but it was a pity that no matter what he did now, it would make her angry. But if he didn't help her, he couldn't bear it, and he felt even more uncomfortable.
He suddenly had an idea and had another good idea. Since she didn't want to make his money, he would go around the corner and help her make other people's money.
Qi Wushuang frowned slightly, with a touch of sadness on his face. He turned around and said to everyone watching: "Dear fellow villagers, my wife and I actually had some misunderstandings, which hurt my wife's heart. That's why she ran away from home and came here to live by selling steamed buns. But my wife's body is not very good. I am really worried that she is too tired. Can you please support me so that my wife can go back to rest early?"
So this young man is here to find a wife? Everyone was chattering. Although they didn't know what was wrong with the two of them, Qi Wushuang showed an affectionate look, which won the sympathy of many people.
"Then... Okay, I'll buy some and take them home to eat." The first person to be moved was an aunt. If her husband could have such affectionate behavior, she would die in peace, so of course she would help him.
"Then...then I'll come with a few." Although a young girl was very sorry that this handsome man had already married, she still wanted to help him, hoping that she could find such a good husband!
"Then let me have one too..."
"I haven't eaten it anyway, so let's have one..."
Unexpectedly, Qi Wushuang just frowned and caught the sympathy of many people. They all came forward to buy buns from Bao An'er. Bao An'er couldn't help being dumbfounded and felt like a loser.
Could it be that sheYou really don’t have the ability to do business, so you have to rely on him?
"If you think it's delicious, you're welcome to come back next time..." Bao'an'er stood aside dumbly, unable to recover for a moment, while Uncle Gui smiled and quickly collected the money to pack the buns, selling them one after another, with very nimble hands and feet, and was happy to see the current development.
"Thank you folks for your help." Qi Wushuang politely thanked everyone. He looked like he loved his wife to the core, which was even more popular.
"Young Master, you have to work harder so that you can get your wife back as soon as possible..."
